card.summary: No free tier. 'Премиум-аккаунт Real Debrid на 90 дней (RD N°3)' 855 RUB; 'Премиум-аккаунт Real Debrid на 180 дней (RD N°4)' 1 520 RUB; instant delivery to em...

record.category: debrid resale - Russian account shop (account, not key)

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable to the resale: the single-object cap is the debrid vendor's, not the shop's

retention.stated: not applicable to the resale: cached-item retention is the debrid vendor's

record.interface_detail: the shop delivers a voucher code or a login by email; the capacity itself is reached through the debrid vendor's REST API
record.tooling: any client that takes the vendor's API key: rclone, JDownloader, Stremio/Torrentio, pyload
record.chaining: a resold voucher only changes how the days are paid for; the stack above it is unchanged
record.binding_note: The account is delivered with the seller's mailbox behind it; the vendor's location check sends its PIN there, so the buyer's first new-network login depends on the seller answering.
record.confidence_note: the seller's page was read; a seller is not the vendor, so nothing here is at the documented rung except the vendor terms quoted in evidence

free_tier.stated: No free tier. 'Премиум-аккаунт Real Debrid на 90 дней (RD N°3)' 855 RUB; 'Премиум-аккаунт Real Debrid на 180 дней (RD N°4)' 1 520 RUB; instant delivery to email.
free_tier.notes: the product is titled 'premium account', not 'voucher' - the buyer receives credentials, not a code to redeem on their own account

egress.terms: the listing restates the vendor's features ('более 80 популярных серверов файлового хостинга'); no byte allowance is published by the shop

limits.value: one holder per account; the seller created the account and keeps its mailbox, so a location change needs the seller

identity_cost.detail: order by email; Russian rails (the site advertises a hotline and WhatsApp/Telegram support). The account's own email is the seller's.

record.reliability_note: Buyer reviews on the page are short and positive (2025-08-10 to 2026-05-07), which is the seller's own wall, not an independent rating.

evidence.proved: 90-day 855 RUB and 180-day 1520 RUB listings, 'Премиум-аккаунт' wording, and dated buyer comments on the page
the 180-day product page at 1520 RUB and four buyer comments dated 2025-08-10 to 2025-08-27 plus one 2026-05-07 testimonial on the category page
the 90-day Real Debrid premium account is listed at 855 руб on the category page, unchanged
the 180-day product page is live and still titled as a premium account at 1520 руб
evidence.quote: Премиум-аккаунт Real Debrid на 180 дней (RD N°4)

record.notes: Vendor baseline, third-party: comparative listings lists Real-Debrid at EUR 3 / 15 days, EUR 4 / 30 days, EUR 9 / 90 days, EUR 16 / 180 days. real-debrid.com/premium returned 403 to read (exa, browserless, contextdev) and to fetch, so the vendor's own table was not read on 2026-11-03. If 1520 RUB is close to EUR 16 at the current rate, this is the only shop found selling at roughly the vendor's own price - because it is selling a hand-made account, not a voucher. The caveat is the mailbox: the buyer cannot reset the password or pass the vendor's new-location PIN without the seller.
